description: This script processes and analyzes Git pack file data, specifically output from 'git verify-pack -v'. It provides statistics such as object sizes, delta chain sizes, delta trees, and depths, and can include detailed tree structure and filenames as options.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Computes statistical measures (count, total, min, max, mean, median, standard deviation) for a list of numerical data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints formatted statistical summary of a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses object tree structures, accumulating size metrics and optionally printing tree structure details.
